parameters: \rZinnia: Now, our tale reaches the best part.
\rSootopolis was born from a great meteoroid strike.
\rThe great meteoroid was the first of many disasters to befall humanity.
\rWhen it punched into the planet, the land cracked beneath it, and a great welling of natural energy poured from beneath Hoenn.
\rThirsting for that energy, Primal Kyogre and Primal Groudon once again woke.
\rThe people had a wish--a memory from a thousand years before…
\rThey wished that the Legendary Pokémon clad in emerald light would appear again.
\rThe huge meteorite that lay at the heart of Sootopolis gave off a boundless brilliance.
\rIn its brilliance, it resembled a vast and powerful Key Stone.
\rAnd once again, Rayquaza descended from whence it came in the heavens.
\rThe people fell to their knees before Rayquaza and made a wish for salvation.
\rAs they did, a great change came over the Legendary Pokémon.
\rIt was enveloped in blinding light.\nAs the light receded, they beheld a Rayquaza beyond all knowledge--\na sublime figure, incandescent with overwhelming life
\rIt was humanity's wish that brought about Rayquaza's transformation in the face of the rainbow stone…
\rYes… A wish…\nAn intangible thing, invisible to the eye.
\rYet this wish bound people and Pokémon together, enabling the Legendary Pokémon to change its appearance…
\rThat's right…\nIt sounds like Mega Evolution, doesn't it?
